audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Skill, Jax, Jax. Level 1 was Skill while whys[0] opens 'Malphite owns level 1'; 2+ items was Jax while whys[6] says he wins the game state late; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were Skill while whys[3] says trade every time his Q slow is down and whys[4] says you win the duel.
audit.why: The mirror audit (malphite__jax) reached the same conclusion on the decisive row and recorded that 2+ items should read Malphite but could not propose the flip from its side. Proposing it here resolves it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 = Malphite, 3 = Jax, 4 = Jax, 6 = Malphite, matching the packet chart, the whys and the mirror, with ratings moved to match. One atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said only 'saved for fights, lane is fine without it' — no numbers on any ability.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1, which is why baiting it is worth a whole lane phase. Seismic Shard is a flat 8s and Ground Slam a flat 7s at every rank, so his poke and his attack-speed cut never scale away — you cannot wait either out, you have to fight through them.
audit.corrected: All three numbers plus the Granite Shield recharge condition written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] said 'when it is down — Q-E-W him' and never mentioned Granite Shield, which is the reason your burst underperforms in this lane.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges only if he has NOT been hit for a few seconds. Every poke you land keeps it down; every time you back off you refund it. That changes how you open a trade and it appeared nowhere on the page. Thunderclap is also an auto-reset — that empowered hit is precisely what Counter Strike is for, and the page said so in the content layer but not in the full-layer do's.
audit.corrected: report[5] rewritten around Granite Shield; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d given the Thunderclap reset and the Ground Slam attack-speed cut.

audit.why: The content layer already states the two things that matter most and states them correctly: Counter Strike does nothing to Seismic Shard because it is a spell, and your magic on-hit cuts through the armour he stacks. No change needed.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1 — it knocks you off your Leap, so bait it or wait. - Seismic Shard: 8s flat slow. - Ground Slam: 7s flat, and it cuts your attack speed. - Granite Shield: recharges only if he is not hit.

edits.before: Track Malphite's Unstoppable Force: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max HP and only recharges when he is left alone — chip it off first.

edits.before: Malphite wastes Unstoppable Force — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Thunderclap resets his auto — that is the hit Counter Strike is for.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap's aftershocks plus Ground Slam's 7s attack-speed cut punish that.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s — force it out and the lane is yours.

edits.before: Burning E on nothing — your counter-stun is the matchup; without it you are a man with a lamppost.
edits.after: His late value is the R flank engage in 5v5s, not the side lane you already win — close it early.

notes: DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE, DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN TO THE PAGE: the kit file tags BOTH Seismic Shard and Ground Slam with grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'). Riot's own descriptions say Q steals Move Speed and E reduces Attack Speed — neither grounds. Per the standing rule I trusted the description over the flag and asserted nothing about Leap Strike being denied. If those flags are right the matchup changes completely, so it is worth a human check on the tooltip parser. suspectNames flagged "Counter Strike's", 'Hold Unstoppable Force' and "Grandmaster's Armor" — the first two are FALSE POSITIVES (real names, one preceded by a verb). The third is loose phrasing for Jax's ultimate, which per the kassadin mirror audit cannot be written correctly into these fields because the applier's elo-tier filter rejects strings containing the word it begins with; the mirror malphite__jax reports it corrected that name on its own side, so the two pages may read differently there.
